scientific_question: After the production-sized hidden64+24+output32 chart is fitted to each exact dense-Muon c_proj update, is the remaining same-gauge residual compact along matrix/channel axes or causally predictable from earlier phase residuals?

theory.target_and_gauge: layers 0-7 dense c_proj weights and exact Muon actions from one accepted repaired-attention plus procedural-c_fc 5TPP trajectory; no cross-run or cross-layer transplantation
theory.paper_link: The Mapping Networks weight-manifold claim and LWT imply layer-local low-dimensional coordinates, but do not imply a fixed affine tangent. This test asks whether the missing local action is compatible with a compact phase-local chart or modulation before changing g(z).
theory.residual_equation: R_l,p = DeltaW_dense_l,p - DeltaW_chart_l,p, where DeltaW_chart is the same hidden64+24+output32 Frobenius chart and identical weight-decay ordering used in the rejected static-metric calibration.
theory.temporal_equation: For each layer, eig(X X^T) with X=[vec(R_l,0);...;vec(R_l,3)] measures noncausal temporal dimension; projection of R_l,p onto span(R_l,<p) separately measures causal predictability.
theory.matrix_equation: eig(R R^T) measures singular energy; row/column energy participation and top-quartile mass test output- and hidden-channel modulation hypotheses.
theory.future_scoring: The within-phase chord W_l,p+1-W_l,p and every later residual are inaccessible to chart construction and used only for scoring.

causal_basis: The corrected static metric calibration rejected activation-only, error-only, and diagonal activation-error selectors; the strongest mean CE gain was 3.45e-5, only 6.91 percent of its frozen gate.
The earlier 0.5TPP stepwise history found local update smoothness but less than 50 percent future-only chord capture through 12 updates, suggesting tangent transport rather than one fixed direction.
Bounded error feedback helped c_proj while unbounded carry failed across scale, so missing update action is causal but a dense persistent residual is not an acceptable compressed solution.
Before proposing phase-local LWT, modulation, low rank, or compact state, the residual itself must select the corresponding branch under frozen thresholds.

measurements: chart fixed-scale exact-update recovery and residual energy fraction
residual singular top-1/4/16/64 energy, stable rank, and participation rank
output and hidden channel top-quartile energy and participation rank
per-layer temporal PC1/2/3 energy across four phases
previous-residual positive-line recovery and causal all-prior span recovery
future phase-chord positive-line recovery by exact update, chart update, and chart residual

controls.singular_isotropic_reference: top64 fraction is approximately 64/768=0.083 for equal singular energy
controls.channel_isotropic_reference: top-quartile mass is 0.25 for equal channel energy
controls.temporal_orthogonal_reference: two-PC energy is 0.5 for four equal-energy orthogonal phase residuals

interpretation.low_dimensional_but_phase_transported: temporal PC2 passes but causal prior-span recovery fails; authorize only phase-local transport-signal design
interpretation.causally_compressible_temporal_residual: causal prior-span recovery passes; authorize only compact residual-state design
interpretation.matrix_low_rank: top-64 singular energy passes; authorize only low-rank structural theory
interpretation.channel_concentrated: output or hidden top-quartile energy passes; authorize only the corresponding structured modulation theory
interpretation.none: do not invent a compact chart; report that the measured residual is diffuse under these axes

execution_policy.mfu_gate: not applicable because this analysis performs zero model or optimizer updates
